title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday! — Episode4 I Hope We Reach Them

meta.Episode: Episode4 — I Hope We Reach Them
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Airi Momoi's here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good morning!
I'm really looking forward to working with all of you today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I knew coming into this, but it's really just wall-to-wall A-listers...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The MC for this show's an incredibly famous comedian too, but here I am, some no-name idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I won't let how I feel get in the way. I put so much effort into memorizing the script, so my parts need to be flawless!)
se_event_everyday_2021_007

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Let's begin our Frankly Frank Talk...!
Our guest today is some girl we found outside, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hi! I'm Airi Momoi... Wait, what do you mean, Some girl?!
se_event_everyday_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I really am an idol!
I perform in a group called QT.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: You are? But my script says that you're a plain-old nobody...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Who wrote this script?! Stand up, I dare you! Explain exactly how I'm a nobody!
se_event_everyday_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Personality
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
This girl's great!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Geez, I almost froze up there...
No one said anything about going off-script this early.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But we're off to a good start and I got a good comeback in. Just follow the conversation and go with the flow from here!)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Airi, check it out!
You got invited onto another variety show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I did? Wait, Morning Kids Station and The Wide World of Laughs...?! These are really famous shows!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, The Wide World of Laughs is having a sports competition? They're doing a scavenger hunt, a giant-ball rolling event...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This is your chance to take center stage and really up QT's name recognition! We're counting on you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah, true...
If I do well here and get our name out there, a big tour might not be out of the question...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll do it.
Leave everything to me!
Three months later
Location shoot

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, you guys!
The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday has arrived!

rows.Speaker: Senior Idol
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Happy Everyday...!
Sorry, Airi, you're still pretty clearly you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I'm Happy Everyday!
se_event_everyday_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Senior Idol
rows.Line: Well, if you say so. I guess we can't really argue.

rows.Speaker: Comedian
rows.Line:
No two idols are the same, huh?
Wait, does this even count as idol work?
se_event_everyday_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Do not underestimate me!
Knowing how to make people laugh is all a part of being a great idol!

rows.Speaker: Comedian
rows.Line: Hang on, isn't that our job?
se_event_everyday_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ugh, enough!
Unless you want... A Happy Idol Punch!

rows.Speaker: Senior Idol
rows.Line: Haha. An idol that punches people?! Classic!
se_event_everyday_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Please take a quick break while we perform some equipment checks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, just a little more and then we're done...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The other QT girls should be doing that mini-event right now. I wish I could've gone...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I have to do my best here...!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line: Hm? They're doing a shoot in a place like this? Hold on...! Isn't that Happy Everyday?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line:
Are they on break or something?
Maybe she'll talk to us!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Do you like Happy Everyday that much?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line:
No, not really.
But it's not every day that you get to meet celebrities, right♪

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line: Still, it's amazing how she does all her own stunts. I'd probably be too scared or embarrassed if I were in her shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Passerby B's Voice
rows.Line: Pipe down, will you... She'll hear us...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line: What? She wouldn't mind, right? I mean, everybody makes fun of her already.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line: At this point, that's kind of her job, isn't it? She'd have nothing to do if nobody was there to push her buttons.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, I see a bunch of comedians over there! Let's go get some autographs!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Whoa, wait for me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I can't let something like that get me down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna be a super idol who can spread hope by singing, dancing and MCing! This is just a little detour!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I can't let what they said...

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Airi?
You look so tired lately.

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line: You have morning shoots on top of your regular shows, right? Have you been getting enough sleep?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm fine, really...
I have more stamina than most people so...!

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
The QT meet and greet will begin momentarily!
We ask that you be patient for just a little while longer!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, our meet and greet's about to start! Smile, Airi, smile♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. Today will be the first time in a while that I met our fans!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've been through a lot already, but this is the reason why we do this...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Let's begin our meet and greet.
Please line up in an orderly manner.

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: Hi, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, it's you! Sanae, right?
We met during our last meet and greet!
Thank you so much for coming!

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line:
You remembered me?! Thank you!
I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: I've been seeing you on TV a lot lately! I couldn't stop laughing that time you did ten bungee jumps in a row!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Sorry, time's up!

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line:
Good luck, Airi!
I'll be cheering you on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I hope we see each other again!

rows.Speaker: Fan B
rows.Line: Airi, Happy Everyday's been such a huge hit! All the boys in my class have been copying you!

rows.Speaker: Fan C
rows.Line: Are you pretty close with that one comedian?

rows.Speaker: Fan D
rows.Line: The gag you did on that one show was hilarious! Hey, can you try doing it right now?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for coming...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry, can I get a drink of water before I see my next guest...?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Man...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Last time, everyone asked me questions about our shows. Today's just been TV this and TV that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I get that me being absent from so many of our shows isn't helping but...)

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: Yu Yu, long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: The mini-event you did the other day was so good! Your solo during your new song was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wait, she came to see me earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: Every time I see you perform, Yu Yu, I'm filled with so much hope! It's like I know tomorrow's going to be a wonderful day! Thank you for everything!

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I really appreciate your support!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Tomorrow's going to be a wonderful day, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna put everything into my singing, dancing and MCing because I want everyone here to have the time of their lives!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to spread hope and make them believe that tomorrow will be better!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the kind of super idol I want to become!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Where's that girl now...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Am I delivering hope to people like I said I would...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nope...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But making people smile is an idol's job.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's not what I envisioned, but as long as I keep trying, maybe someday I'll...!)
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, I guess I fell asleep while making props for games...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm getting all nostalgic in my dreams now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But sometime after that, I overheard something that my manager said...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. I'd like Airi to start focusing on becoming more of a variety show personality...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Honestly, as an idol, she's pretty run of the mill, so I'd like to shift her work away from that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no point in dwelling on that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right now, I need to focus on what I can do for our fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I know what I need to do, but...)
